stage1.impression: A view from the street through a shopfront into a long, warm listening bar: a curved counter, a lit record wall, banquettes, and two small red speakers at the far end. It reads as a competent but soft CG render. A uniform brown haze flattens everything, and the glass shows no reflections, so there is no sense of standing outside it. The EARF pair, the reason for the room, is a pair of tiny red tiles that read like signage, and two green glows compete with them. As it stands a magazine would see a generic warm bar, not a specific place: the altar, the zinc and the etched name do not register.

blocking_9: The Ember pair must read as the hero at a glance: larger in frame (at least 6% of frame height each) and not blown (clip_pct < 2 on the cabinets)

The glass must behave like glass seen from the kerb: faint reflections of the street lamps and the street, with the etched name reading as frosted letters cut into clear glass, not a beige square patch
Frame lum_median 30 to 48 with real blacks (lum_p5 <= 10) and pools of light separated by dark; at the moment haze and exposure give a flat, uniform mid-tone
The steel mullion must not split the frame at its centre or sit against the left speaker
The counter must read as zinc (cool, grey, patinated metal sheen) against the fir and concrete; it reads as warm brown timber now
Materials at 1:1 (floor, concrete, beams) need texture and grain, not smooth smeared surfaces

defects.what: Left Ember speaker: 10% clipped, half hidden by the mullion, about 36 px tall at proof scale; reads as a red sign with a white disc
Right Ember speaker: 13.7% clipped, its face blown to pink-white; the acrylic does not read as tinted cast acrylic with batts inside
Black steel mullion runs down the exact centre of the frame and cuts into the altar
Etched name: reads as an opaque beige square sticker with a dark E, not frosted letters in clear glass
Frosted lightbox: a flat, even field (median 94, range 93) covering about 12% of the frame; the dancer silhouette is a vague smudge and the box reads as signage
No reflections on the shopfront glass at all; the street lamps leave no trace on the glass or the steel
Back of the room veiled by haze (p5 23, no true dark); the green Domes over the altar add a second saturated colour beside the red speakers
The record wall is the brightest large area in the frame (median 112) and pulls the eye away from the altar; the record spines read as a repeated texture
Counter top reads warm brown and wood-like (r131 g98 b78), not zinc
Floor is smooth and smeared by the denoiser, with no polish texture or aggregate; light falls off evenly with no pools
Rows of identical stools and tables in a regular line read as one model copied many times
Glowing green Dome cover above the speaker floats like an emissive blob with no light falling from it

changes.problem: The hero speakers are tiny and the mullion bisects the frame right beside the left speaker.

evidence.measured: speakers about 36 px tall of 480 (7.5%), about 20 px wide; mullion edge at x 392 to 408, touching the left cabinet at x 403

change.to: position [-1.2, 2.4, 1.45], target [16.0, 3.6, 1.2], 45 mm; check that the shopfront frame still borders the left and right edges, and that the mullion falls at about 0.3 of the width, clear of the altar

changes.expected: The Ember pair grows to about 10 to 12% of frame height and sits on a third line, unobstructed; the shopfront still frames the picture as seen from the kerb.

changes.problem: The frame is too bright and flat for night, with no real blacks.
changes.expected: Frame median about 40, blacks to about 8, the back of the room clears so the altar separates from its wall.

changes.problem: The Ember cabinets are blown, so the tinted acrylic and the batts behind it read as a flat pink sign.

change.setting: lamps on each Ember speaker; altar spots
change.from: 4 x area 14.0 W/m2; altar 2 x spot 40 W cone 40 deg
change.to: 4 x area 7.0 W/m2; altar 2 x spot 60 W, cone 28 deg, aimed at the floor in front of and the plinth under the pair so they sit in a pool

changes.expected: The cabinets hold deep red with visible depth and edge glow, ringed by a pool of warm light on the altar; no clipping.

changes.problem: The record wall is the brightest large area and steals the eye from the altar.

evidence.measured: lum_median 111.7, brighter than the altar region (67.7)

change.to: 4 x spot 14 W, cone 24 deg, so the spines catch scalloped pools with dark between them

changes.expected: The record wall drops to a secondary pool, median about 55 to 65 after the exposure change, with visible scallops.

changes.problem: The etched name reads as a beige opaque patch, and the glass shows no reflection, so the kerb viewpoint does not read.

evidence.measured: uniform beige square (median 83, r110 g77 b57) around a dark E; whole glass plane has no specular events

change.setting: the window's etched name emission; shopfront glass finish
change.from: etched name 0.01 over a square region; glass with no visible reflection
change.to: etched name 0.0, with frosted roughness (about 0.4) on the letter shapes only and the rest of the glass clear; glass Fresnel reflection kept on so the three street lamps and the kerb show as faint (3 to 6%) reflections, plus a slight smudge or roughness map

changes.expected: Frosted letters catch the room's light from behind, the glass between them is clear, and faint street-lamp reflections place the viewer outside.

changes.problem: The frosted lightbox is a big, flat, bright field that reads as signage, with the silhouette lost in it.

evidence.measured: lum_median 94, p95 105: an even field over 12% of the frame

change.setting: the lightbox's emission (screens' brightness) and the frosted acrylic's roughness
change.from: even emission at about frame median x1.6; high roughness
change.to: emission down about 40% with a soft top-to-bottom gradient from back-lighting; roughness lowered a little so the dancer's silhouette sharpens at its nearest points

changes.expected: The box glows softly at about 55 to 65 median with a readable figure, as a frosted panel and not a lightbox sign.

changes.problem: The counter's zinc does not read; the top looks like warm wood.

evidence.measured: r131 g98 b78, warm brown; no cool metallic sheen

change.to: zinc with lower roughness (about 0.3), a cool grey base near #8A8D8C with a mottled patina map, so the Dome downlights land as soft elongated highlights

changes.expected: The counter top reads as grey metal with soft hot spots under the Domes, set against the fir.

changes.problem: The floor and lower room are smooth and smeared, with no pools of light.

evidence.measured: lum_range 67.8 and a monotonic falloff of 98 to 47 with no pools; smeared texture on the crop

change.from: smooth floor; denoise on with adaptive 0.02
change.to: polished concrete with an aggregate and trowel map, roughness about 0.25 so the Domes and table lamps reflect as soft pools; adaptive threshold 0.01 to cut denoiser smear

changes.expected: Pools of reflected light under the tables and counter; the floor has texture at 1:1.

out_of_scope.request: Swap the green Dome covers over the altar for smoked ones, so the red speakers are the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: The Dome covers are an EARF product and the bottle-green zone is fixed room design; it is the owner's call

out_of_scope.request: Vary the identical stools and tables (mixed pieces, slight rotation, things left on them)
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed by the room's design; only their placement and small props could help, and rotating them may count as a layout change

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers bigger in frame beyond what the lens allows
out_of_scope.why: The altar is at the back wall 17 m deep by design; from the kerb the hero will always be small, so a closer shot is needed for the speaker to dominate
